access: Read frozen protocol, lock, code and emitted results; verified pinned byte hashes and result summaries. No source-window scan or controls rerun. No report available for review.
algorithm_review: Primary compares every recurrence against its first occurrence. These 25 comparisons enforce a single value for each of 52 exact whole forms without imposing different values for different forms.
All source starts admitting a complete 77-letter window are considered. Reverse uses 76-index for every position, equivalent to whole-message reversal, not local orientation choice.
Independent validator reconstructs a fresh one-way dictionary at each start and admits collisions; no injective reverse dictionary is used. Its first-failure counts agree with sequential filtering.
scientific_conclusion: The complete selected IT passage cannot have a fixed context-independent one-normalized-letter-per-whole-group decoding into any of these fixed ALIM553 projection windows, in either declared direction. Source word boundaries may be anywhere because they have been erased; SPACE output from a group is not included in this letters-only contract.

chronology_review.facts_as_disclosed: Independent validator development controls (11730 comparisons plus five named checks) were already run before the common lock; their success is not blind. PREREGISTRATION and CONTROL_CHRONOLOGY explicitly distinguish them from later primary registered controls and empirical runs. The frozen validator repeats them.
chronology_review.limit: Disclosure is consistent with the frozen files and reported chronology. File hashes alone do not independently prove wall-clock absence of earlier empirical access; no stronger forensic claim is made.
